cards.title: Supporting a Pregnant Friend Without Baby Experience
cards.body: Worried you're not good with babies? Eleanor Gordon-Smith's advice column reassures that every child is different, and you won't truly know how you'll connect until you meet this specific baby. Being a supportive friend doesn't require expert baby skills—just genuine care and willingness to learn.

cards.title: Adult Child Moving Back Home: Parenting Reset
cards.body: When adult children return to the family nest for financial reasons, parents face a shift from empty-nest independence to active parenting again. Emma Beddington explores the adjustment period and how both generations navigate this unexpected second chapter.

cards.title: Relocation Dilemma: Family Proximity Before School Starts
cards.body: Parents considering moving closer to family before their daughter starts school must weigh isolation against building new local roots. Annalisa Barbieri addresses the real costs—both emotional and practical—of relocating for family support.

cards.title: Leaving Family Behind for Adventure: Parent Responsibility
cards.body: Emma Beddington questions whether it's ethical for parents to abandon families—including young children—to pursue wilderness adventures. The debate explores balancing personal ambitions with parental obligations and family stability.
